a.xlink:title: First 802.1Q tag. 802.1Q and 802.1ad share one two-tag budget (the source's shared `max_var = vlan` counter), so a second tag of either entry continues at `parse_vlan_q2`.
First tag, 802.1ad entry: followed only by an 802.1Q tag (spending the shared budget's second slot) or 802.1ah/PBB.
First of the five bounded MPLS labels (`max = 5`).
Second tag (either entry): the shared budget is exhausted, so further VLAN TPIDs fall to the default.
The inner Ethernet every tunnel bottoms out in - terminal in the source (its `ethernet2` node has no dispatch map).
Bottom of stack: the source's 4-bit pseudo-field, extracted here as a real header (see the module docstring).
Fifth label: the bound is exhausted, so bos=0 (a sixth label) falls to the default - not a recognized sequence.
UDP dispatches VXLAN on dstPort 65535 - the source's made-up value (it predates the 4789 assignment) [sic].
First of the three bounded GREs (`max = 3`); dispatch keys on (K, proto) concatenated, so both arms require K=1.
The source's AH map, transcribed as-is - it includes ICMPv6 even when AH was reached off the IPv4 path.
Third GRE: the bound is exhausted, so the nested-GRE arm falls to the default.
